verdict.rationale: The pack contains no published guidance on choosing an entity type or jurisdiction of incorporation, such as Delaware C-corp vs UK Ltd vs GmbH/UG vs Indian Pvt Ltd. The closest item is the 2026 Startup Notification analysis, which covers Indian DPIIT startup-recognition criteria and notes that flip structures are ineligible. That is regulatory-recognition commentary, not entity or jurisdiction selection guidance, so it is only adjacent. The practice pages describe advisory services for startups, not published formation guides.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
